_comment: The nine systems evaluated in the paper, each run through its vendor's agent CLI against the vendor's official API. Copy to systems.json (and the keys to keys.env). model/effort: what the harness must request (the gateway rejects anything else); effort is the paper's setting (antigravity takes low|medium|high, the other harnesses up to max). harness: codex | claude | antigravity | dsh | kimi | zcode (docs/harnesses.md). upstream: API base URL WITHOUT the /v1 or /v1beta part (the gateway appends the path the harness sends, e.g. /v1/messages, /v1/responses, /v1/chat/completions, /v1beta/models/...). key_file: relative to this file. key_vars: variables of keys.env, used in order; a key out of credit is set aside and the next one used. Optional: harness_install (entry of controller/config.json "harness" to use instead of the harness name; gpt6_astra needs a newer Codex CLI), strip_path_prefix (path prefix removed before appending, for an upstream base that already holds the API version: glm53_flash, whose z.ai base ends in /api/paas/v4), proxy (HTTP proxy URL for this upstream; default: environment http(s)_proxy, else direct), upstream_model (model id sent upstream instead of model), extra_body (fields added to every request; glm53_flash streams tool-call arguments with tool_stream, as in the paper's runs).
